newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ASX, ASC in Indonesian alliance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ASX, ASC in Indonesian alliance.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Thursday it had formalised strategic relationships with the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges in Indonesia.
ASX chairman Maurice Newman said that with the increasingly global nature of the securities industry, such alliances were important.
"With such rapid change in the nature of global securities markets, it is desirable that we build co-operative alliances with other markets in our region," Newman said in a statement.
The ASX said the memorandums of understanding formalise lines of communications between the ASX and the two Indonesian exchanges.

Complementary to the ASX's alliance, the Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said it had entered into a memorandum of understanding with its Indonesian counterpart, Badan Pengwar Pasar Modal (BAPEPAM), the Capital Market Supervisory Agency.

The ASC said its agreement aimed to enhance investor protection in Australia and Indonesia by ensuring that investigation of breaches of securities laws were not frustrated by jurisdictional difficulties associated with cross-border enforcement activities.
